reviews.text:
Has a minty feeling. Reminds me of the Amuse Bebe Tint formulation. It's thin and will not cover any peeling lips.

It does leave behind a heavy stain on my palm but since it's so close to my lip color, it barely stains my lips.

Color is a muted soft neutral leaning cool pink. Smells like mentholated lip balm. Wish I had gotten a darker color.
reviews.zh: 有薄荷嘅感覺。令我想起 Amuse Bebe Tint 嘅質地。質地薄，遮唔到脫皮嘅嘴唇。雖然會喺掌心留低明顯嘅染色，但因為太接近我本身嘅唇色，所以基本上唔會染到我嘅嘴。顏色係偏冷調嘅柔和粉紅。氣味似薄荷潤唇膏。希望當初揀咗深色啲嘅色號。

reviews.text: goes on a little whitish on my lips. size is generous but don't plan on repurchasing it. i needed something that would last long but this one does not.
reviews.zh: 搽上嘴之後有少少泛白。容量幾大但唔打算再回購。我想要持久嘅產品，呢支完全唔得。

reviews.text: It has a slight stinging feel, but it doesn’t hurt like other plumping effect lip products. Color is very bright and it leaves a long lasting tint. When the gloss comes off the tint is still very pretty.
reviews.zh: 有少少刺刺嘅感覺，但唔似其他丰唇產品咁痛。顏色好鮮明，會留低持久嘅染色。當光澤退咗之後，染出嚟嘅顏色仲係好靚。

reviews.text: Very pretty color, and leaves a smooth stain. The plumping effect feels cooling, but I didn’t notice much additional volume. I hope they expand the shade range, this formula is great!
reviews.zh: 顏色好靚，而且會留有平滑嘅染唇效果。豐唇效果感覺涼涼地，但我冇乜感覺到額外嘅豐盈感。希望佢哋可以擴展色號範圍，呢個配方好正！

reviews.text: Love this formula! The plumping effect feels cooling, but I didn’t notice much additional volume. The tint is really pretty though (there’s a bit more pink in it than comes through in the picture), and lasts really well. I hope they expand the shades, this stained and lasted like I’d hoped all the glam tints would.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢個配方！豐唇效果感覺涼涼地，但我冇乜感覺到額外嘅豐盈度。不過顏色真係好靚（比起相片顯示再多一啲粉紅調），而且持久度好好。希望佢哋可以擴充色號，呢款染唇效果同持久度，就係我一直希望所有 glam tint 都可以做到嘅。

reviews.text: The color is very pretty and glossy! It has a plumping effect, the minty feeling is not too strong or painful. It lasts quite a while through the day. I love Laka tints!
reviews.zh: 顏色好靚好有光澤！有豐唇效果，薄荷感唔會太強烈或者刺痛。可以撐到成日。我好鍾意 Laka 嘅 tint！

reviews.text: The LAKA Popping Balloon Tint is adorable and effective! Its bouncy, cushion applicator and vibrant color deliver a playful, glossy finish that feels light and hydrating. Easy to wear with a long-lasting pop of fruity charm—perfect for bright, fun lips! Highly recommended! 🎈
reviews.zh: LAKA Popping Balloon Tint 可愛又實用！佢嘅彈性 cushion 頭同鮮明嘅顏色帶嚟 playful、有光澤嘅妝效，感覺輕盈又保濕。易於使用，仲有持久嘅 fruity 魅力，啱曬明亮有趣嘅唇妝！高度推薦！🎈

reviews.text: Has a minty feeling (ig its for lip plumping?) Colour doesnt really match the picture - its more of a coral colour on my lips. Tints pretty well though and gloss is decent.
reviews.zh: 有薄荷感覺（我估係用嚟豐唇？）。顏色同相片唔太似——喺我唇上比較似珊瑚色。不過染唇效果幾好，光澤度都算唔錯。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
